Introduction | colours: background dark blue; title text white | key text: HKU Robocon team has been established to participate the Robocon Hong Kong competition since 2004. Most of the research and development of all robots are conducted by students from various engineering disciplines, supervision and technical support from faculty facility staff. As a robot involves many components, students are required to have knowledge on different disciplines, which is uncommon among non-undergraduate students, hence requires extensive training. In this poster, the training process will be emphasized. Through such hands-on learning activities, the students' problem-solving, communication, teamwork and leadership skills would be enhanced. As a result, they can be trained to solve a real-work problem in an innovative way.

Background | colours: background dark blue; title text white | key text: The Robocon Hong Kong competition is hosted annually and has a specific theme for each year. Here, this poster mainly presents the training process for the Robocon Hong Kong 2024 competition. The Hong Kong Robocon Contest involves multi-stream knowledges in electronics, programming and mechanical design. Students are required to have sufficient background knowledge on streams to make sure the robot will integrate smoothly. While designing the robot, students are divided into three streams: mechanical, electronic and Software. The mechanical stream is responsible for the design and manufacture of the robot's mechanical parts. The electronics stream designs the power system and circuitry used by the robot. The programming stream writes firmware and software to control and utilize the robot.
